verse.verse_1: By the winds which scatter dust,
verse.verse_2: which carry clouds laden with water,
verse.verse_4: and execute the great task of apportioning (rainfall):
verse.verse_5: surely what you are being warned against is true,
verse.verse_6: and the Judgement shall doubtlessly take place.
verse.verse_7: By the heaven with its numerous forms:
verse.verse_8: surely you are at variance (about the Hereafter);
verse.verse_9: though only those who are averse to the Truth will turn away from (believing in it).
verse.verse_11: who are steeped in ignorance and heedlessness.
verse.verse_12: They ask: “When will the Day of Judgement be?”
verse.verse_13: It will be the Day when they shall be scourged by the Fire
verse.verse_14: (and be told): “Taste your ordeal! This is what you were seeking to hasten.”
verse.verse_15: As for the God-fearing, they shall be in the midst of gardens and fountains,
verse.verse_16: joyously receiving what their Lord will have granted them. Verily they did good works before (the coming of this Day):
verse.verse_17: they used to sleep but little by night,
verse.verse_18: and would ask for forgiveness at dawn,
verse.verse_19: and in their wealth there was a rightful share for him who would ask and for the destitute.
verse.verse_20: There are many Signs on earth for those of sure faith,
verse.verse_21: and also in your own selves. Do you not see?
verse.verse_22: And in heaven is your provision and also what you are being promised.
verse.verse_23: So, by the Lord of the heaven and the earth, this is certainly true, as true as the fact of your speaking.
verse.verse_24: (O Prophet), did the story of Abraham's honoured guests reach you?
verse.verse_25: When they came to him, they said: “Peace”; he said: “Peace also be to you; (you seem to be) a group of strangers.”
verse.verse_26: Then he went back to his family and brought a fat roasted calf
verse.verse_27: and laid it before them, saying: “Will you not eat?”
verse.verse_28: Then he became afraid of them. They said: “Fear not,” and announced to him the good news of (the birth of) a boy endowed with knowledge.
verse.verse_29: So hearing his wife went forth shouting. She struck her face and exclaimed: “A barren old woman am I.”
verse.verse_30: They said: “So has your Lord said (that you shall have a boy). Surely He is Most Wise, All-Knowing.”
verse.verse_31: Abraham said: “Envoys (of Allah), what is your errand?”
verse.verse_32: They replied: “Behold, we have been sent to a wicked people
verse.verse_33: that we may unleash a shower of clay-stones
verse.verse_34: marked by your Lord upon those who go beyond the limits.”
verse.verse_35: Then We evacuated there from all the believers
verse.verse_36: – and We did not find there any, apart from a single house of Muslims –
verse.verse_37: and We left therein a Sign for those who fear the grievous chastisement.
verse.verse_38: There is also a Sign for you in the story of Moses when We sent him with a clear authority to Pharaoh.
verse.verse_39: But Pharaoh turned away, showing arrogance on account of his power, and said (about Moses): “He is either a sorcerer or a madman.”
verse.verse_40: So We seized him and his hosts, and cast them into the sea. He became an object of much blame.
verse.verse_41: There is also a Sign for you in (the story of) Ad, when We let loose upon them an ominous wind
verse.verse_42: that left nothing that it came upon without reducing it to rubble.
verse.verse_43: There is also a Sign for you in (the story of) Thamud. They were told: “Enjoy yourselves for a while.”
verse.verse_44: But they brazenly disobeyed their Lord's command, and then a sudden chastisement overtook them while they looked on.
verse.verse_45: They were unable even to stand up or protect themselves.
verse.verse_46: Before all these We destroyed the people of Noah: they were a wicked people.
verse.verse_47: And heaven – We made it with Our Own Power and We have the Power to do so.
verse.verse_48: And the earth – We spread it out, and how well have We smoothed it!
verse.verse_49: And of everything We have created pairs; perhaps you will take heed.
verse.verse_50: Flee, therefore, to Allah. Surely I am a clear warner to you from Him;
verse.verse_51: and do not set up any deity with Allah. Surely I am a clear warner to you from Him.
verse.verse_52: Thus has it been (in the past): never did a Messenger come to the nations that preceded them but they said: “(He is) a sorcerer, or a mad-man.”
verse.verse_53: Have they arrived at a common understanding concerning this? No; but they are a people given to transgression.
verse.verse_54: So turn your attention away from them; you shall incur no blame.
verse.verse_55: Do, however, keep exhorting them; for exhortation benefits those endowed with faith.
verse.verse_56: I created the jinn and humans for nothing else but that they may serve Me;
verse.verse_57: I desire from them no provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.
verse.verse_58: Surely Allah is the Bestower of all provision, the Lord of all power, the Strong.
verse.verse_59: The wrong-doers shall receive a portion of the chastisements as their fellows (of yore). So let them not rush Me.
verse.verse_60: Woe, then, betide those who disbelieved in that Day of theirs which they are being asked to hold in dread.
